title: National Immunization Schedule — BCG
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
source_label: Universal Immunization Program, National Immunization Schedule
text: BCG vaccine is scheduled at birth. If it was not given earlier, it may be given up to one year of age. The cited schedule identifies the intradermal route and one dose.

title: National Immunization Schedule — Oral Polio Vaccine
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
source_label: Universal Immunization Program, National Immunization Schedule
text: The National Immunization Schedule lists oral polio vaccine: a birth dose for institutional deliveries, primary doses at 6, 10, and 14 weeks, and one booster at 16 to 24 months of age.

title: National Immunization Schedule — Hepatitis B
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
source_label: Universal Immunization Program, National Immunization Schedule
text: For institutional deliveries, Hepatitis B has a birth dose within 24 hours. The schedule also lists primary doses at 6, 10, and 14 weeks.

title: National Immunization Schedule — DPT
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
source_label: Universal Immunization Program, National Immunization Schedule
text: The National Immunization Schedule lists three DPT doses at 6, 10, and 14 weeks, then booster doses at 16 to 24 months and at 5 to 6 years of age.

title: PMSMA — high-risk pregnancy identification and follow-up
authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
text: PMSMA identifies and follows up high-risk pregnancies. The programme describes using red stickers on Mother and Child Protection cards for women with high-risk pregnancies.

title: PMSMA — fixed-day antenatal care
authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
text: PMSMA provides fixed-day assured, comprehensive antenatal care to pregnant women in the second and third trimesters on the 9th of every month at government health facilities. The minimum package includes investigations and medicines such as IFA and calcium supplements.
